item.title: Emperor images, WWII memes: Trump pushes back against summit critics
item.description: The White House has framed the trilateral meeting as necessary for "the safety of the world," despite claims that it alienated allies like Japan.

item.title: Visions of Japan overrun by humanoid robot imports inspire startups
item.description: The country is lagging in development of bipedal machines that can perform useful tasks.

item.title: Hiroshima joins forces with bus operators to redraw local routes
item.description: The public-private partnership involving eight operators aims to optimize the network in the face of declining ridership and financial challenges.

item.title: Studio Ghibli composer Joe Hisaishi given honorary doctorate by U.K. college
item.description: Hisaishi became the first Japanese to receive an honorary doctorate from the college.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
